decisions.reason: Cleaning soap is a low-cost complementary care product that supports floor sales and fits the firm's maintenance offering.
Maintenance oil for oiled floors is a core accessory with recurring demand and synergy with the firm's surface treatments.
The care line for oiled floors complements the established offer and generates repeat purchases at little added cost.
Moisture-protection underlay is a standard installation accessory that installers expect alongside the floors.
High-density underlay adds value for acoustic and performance installations, though it could later be consolidated with other underlays.
Oak parquet is central to the firm's core business and design range, so it is very likely to be kept.
